import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import active_quench_adaptive as AD

def construct_packing():
    C, r, S = AD.adaptive_finalize(
        total_sec=1200.0,
        seed=20251207,
        segment_sec=30.0,
        eta_S=5e-6,
        eta_slack=1e-7,
        gamma_alpha=0.6,
        dK=12,
        k_pairs_init=176,
        alpha0_init=1.2e-4,
        boundary_push_init=0.64,
        boundary_push_min=0.58,
        pair_margin=5e-12,
        boundary_margin=2e-12
    )
    # Minimal validity checks (let evaluator enforce exact constraints)
    assert C.shape == (26,2) and r.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(r > 0)
    return C, r
